distribution.summary: 福建；广东；广西；贵州；海南；河南；香港；湖北；湖南；江苏；江西；四川；云南；浙江；台湾
distribution.narrative: Baseline sources and Smith et al. (2020) support the earlier reviewed range. Lin et al. (2024) adds Henan. Beaver & Liu (2010) independently supports Taiwan and Lau (2025) independently supports Hong Kong. Smith et al. (2022) reports Fujian, Guangdong, Guangxi, Guizhou, Hainan, Hong Kong, Hubei, Hunan, Jiangsu, Jiangxi, Sichuan, Yunnan, Zhejiang and Taiwan; these are all already contained in the current synthesis, so no region is added.

host_note: The current host synthesis, including Yulania denudata added by Lin et al. (2024), is retained. Smith et al. (2022) reports no host in the integrated record and adds no host taxon.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Xylosandrus compactus (Eichhoff, 1876).
